notes.title: Demo Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45171299/7c9e8f02c8c383e18c240db65d4fd0e020844c1a.png[/img]
As the title says, the demo is now available!

The demo is the same as the full game and will be available until a few hours before release after which it will be reduced to only a part of the game.

notes.title: Open Beta!
notes.notes:
There is not much to say, but open beta/playtest is now live!

If you would like to provide feedback (bugs, features or other ways to improve the game) join the discord, an invite link can be found in the game's main screen.
